mapper.insert: insert into ai_config_audit ( table_name, record_id, operation, old_value, new_value, operator, created_at ) values ( #{tableName}, #{recordId}, #{operation}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, #{operator}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: select id, table_name, record_id, operation, old_value, new_value, operator, created_at from ai_config_audit where table_name = #{tableName} and record_id = #{recordId}
